records.caution: The 27 published column assignments are reproduced from The Dead Sea Scrolls Study Edition, p. 252, which cites N. Jastram, DJD XII, 205–267. This column map is not a fragment-group map. The Qumran-Digital page's 52 display groups represent fragment numbers 1–109, but only frg. 1–4 has been individually mapped here; the Study Edition explicitly leaves fragments 85–109 without a passage assignment. Masoretic and Samaritan comparison lines on Qumran-Digital are not 4Q27 readings. A verse-by-verse digital line map is now recorded for the first group (frg. 1–4), based on Qumran-Digital's own line annotations. Its comparison text is not part of 4Q27. The fifth displayed group (frg. 12) is now mapped line by line to Numbers 18:25–32 and 19:1–6. Parallel references to 4Q23 and 5/6Hev1a are separate manuscript witnesses and are not part of 4Q27.

records.line_map_policy: Passage ranges above are the verse references attached to each digital transcription line by Qumran-Digital. They are navigational comparisons, not claims that every word in the cited verses is preserved. The Hebrew manuscript transcription is the manuscript witness; MT and Samaritan Pentateuch lines are separate comparison witnesses. The second mapped group frg. 3 ii+5 is individually indexed to Numbers 13:7–24. Its cross-manuscript parallels (including 4Q365) remain distinct witnesses. The third mapped group frg. 6–10 preserves the digital page's discontinuous line labels (11–19, 21–24, 28–30); omitted labels are not reconstructed. The fourth mapped group frg. 11 is recorded using its actual displayed line labels 6–12 and maps to Numbers 17:12–17; it is not conflated with the preceding group frg. 6–10.
